checked_markdown_lines: Applied Statics and Strength of Materials: Hooke law applies while stress is proportional to strain and the proportional limit is not exceeded. Locator: Applied Statics and Strength refined markdown lines 10370-10436, 11155-11227, 11261-11296, and 12069-12269

Applied Statics and Strength of Materials: The elastic limit is the greatest stress without permanent elongation after unloading; many practical treatments use it close to the proportional limit. Locator: Applied Statics and Strength refined markdown lines 10370-10436, 11155-11227, 11261-11296, and 12069-12269

Applied Statics and Strength of Materials: The yield point begins plastic behavior; ultimate strength is the maximum stress; rupture is the breaking point. Locator: Applied Statics and Strength refined markdown lines 10370-10436, 11155-11227, 11261-11296, and 12069-12269

Applied Statics and Strength of Materials: Ductility, brittleness, malleability, toughness, resilience, and Poisson ratio are defined from material behavior and tests. Locator: Applied Statics and Strength refined markdown lines 10370-10436, 11155-11227, 11261-11296, and 12069-12269

Applied Statics and Strength of Materials: Modulus of elasticity is the stress-to-strain ratio in the linear range; shear modulus relates shear stress to shear strain. Locator: Applied Statics and Strength refined markdown lines 10370-10436, 11155-11227, 11261-11296, and 12069-12269

Mechanics and Strength of Materials: Elastic deformation is recoverable and plastic deformation is non-recoverable. Locator: Mechanics and Strength refined markdown lines 4685-4709, 4996-5318, 5394-5548, and 5882-6339

Mechanics and Strength of Materials: Ductile materials undergo substantial plastic deformation before rupture; brittle materials rupture with little non-elastic deformation. Locator: Mechanics and Strength refined markdown lines 4685-4709, 4996-5318, 5394-5548, and 5882-6339

Mechanics and Strength of Materials: Creep is deformation increase over time without a load change. Locator: Mechanics and Strength refined markdown lines 4685-4709, 4996-5318, 5394-5548, and 5882-6339

Mechanics and Strength of Materials: Young modulus, shear modulus, bulk modulus, and Poisson coefficient describe linear elastic behavior. Locator: Mechanics and Strength refined markdown lines 4685-4709, 4996-5318, 5394-5548, and 5882-6339

Mechanics and Strength of Materials: Elastic work can be stored and recovered when the stress-strain relation is the same during loading and unloading. Locator: Mechanics and Strength refined markdown lines 4685-4709, 4996-5318, 5394-5548, and 5882-6339
